reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2028
reviews_list.review_title: Average college.

review_content.Placements: Mainly, all students are placed, but some are not placed due to low CGPA and do not fulfill the criteria of the company. Mainly, students got placed in the Chetu company for a software engineer role with an average package of 3 LPA to 5LPA. Major sales companies come, and also some tech or good companies come.
review_content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is very bad, and Wi-Fi is good in classrooms but bad in the hostel. The labs and library are average. The hostel facility is the worst, and the behavior of the warden is very bad. I never suggest that you go to a hostel, and the food is also very bad, and many times, a chair or an insect is found in the food.

reviews_list.batch_info: Bachelor of Pharmacy (B.Pharm.) - Batch of 2025
reviews_list.review_title: Accurate college is good. This college is worth your money.

review_content.Placements: 50 percent of the pharmacy students got placed. If they have knowledge, the average package offered is 4 LPA. Many companies come to this college. Jubilant Life Sciences offers a good package for students of the Accurate College of Pharmacy and offers a 4 LPA package.
review_content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is average, and the classrooms are average. In the hostel, the food is bad, but everything else is good. Whenever I go to our friend's room in the hostel, they always say hostel life is good.
review_content.Faculty: Teachers are highly knowledgeable and helpful. They understand the students according to the students' capacity and help accordingly in the course of B. Pharm. The study is hard every semester, has different challenges, and 50 percent is the passing percentage. The faculty is good in this college.

reviews_list.batch_info: Bachelor of Pharmacy (B.Pharm.) - Batch of 2025
reviews_list.review_title: Very good and accurate college.

review_content.Placements: This college placement is good, but the main point depends on you and your knowledge. Your placement depends on your knowledge and your work. The main thing is that the college gives you the opportunity for placement. If you can do the job, then they will select you.
review_content.Infrastructure: Facilities provided are good, like proper classroom conditions, good labs, and all the equipment available in our college. Hostel conditions are good and available at a minimal cost.
review_content.Faculty: Our college faculty is the best because they teach like a friend and understand the students’ problems, where they get confused, and how to solve their problems. The exam schedule is not good because sometimes we are surprised to see the datasheet of exam. My course is B.Pharma, and this course is good for a good future and life survival.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: Enjoyed the events, but placements could be better. Peaceful campus with good facilities.

review_content.Placements: Around 90 percent of students in my course are placed through campus placements. The highest package is 9 LPA and the lowest package is 2 LPA. The average package stood at 4 LPA. Some of the top companies that hire from our course include TCS Infosys Wipro Accenture Capgemini Deloitte and more. Some of the common job roles are software developer business analyst data analyst project coordinator and sales/marketing.
review_content.Infrastructure: The facilities available in our classrooms include Wi Fi labs a library a water cooler and A/C. The quality of facilities in our hostel is also good. The rooms are clean and of decent size, usually shared by 2 or 3 students. Wi-Fi is available in the hostels as well. There is a 24/7 supply of water and electricity with backup support. The quality of food available in the mess is good, and the medical facilities are very good. For sports, there are outdoor grounds for cricket, football, volleyball, etc. Indoor games like table tennis, carrom, and chess are also available. Some hostels or campuses even have a gym with basic equipment.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Internet of Things) - Batch of 2028
reviews_list.review_title: The college is worthy and it will give us the best result in our final year.

review_content.Placements: It has a 100% placement guarantee. The highest package is 2 crore per annum and the lowest package ranges from 10-12 LPA. Infosys, Google, etc., are the big companies that come to recruit students. Accurate Institute of Management & Technology provides better internship programs in other colleges in Greater Noida.
review_content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is very nice especially labs are so amazing. Hostel rooms are up to date and the mess food is quite better than other hostels. The campus provides a very nice field to play. It provides a gym facility by which students' health gets very nice.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning) - Batch of 2028
reviews_list.review_title: Supportive faculty and active campus life, average infrastructure, moderate placements.

review_content.Placements: I am from the B.Teach CSE batch of 2024. Approximately 60-70% of students got placed, mostly in service-based companies. The highest package offered was around 10 LPA (off-campus), while the lowest was around 2.5 LPA, and the average package hovered around 3.5 to 4 LPA. Top recruiters include TCS, Wipro, Teach Mahindra, HCL, and some startups. About 40% of students received internships, usually with local companies or via platforms like Internshala and LinkedIn. Common roles include java developed, python developed, web developed, and support engineer.

admission_overview.title: Accurate Group of Institutions Admission Overview 2025
admission_overview.description: Accurate Group of Institutions admission to courses is primarily entrance-based. The institute accepts various national-level entrance exams to shortlist candidates for admission to various AGI courses. For instance, candidates seeking admission to the PGDM course are required to have a valid scorecard of CAT/ MAT/ XAT/ ATMA/ CMAT/ GMAT. The application forms for the Accurate Group of Institutions course admission are released online on the official website of the Institute. Accurate Group of Institutions offers more than ten courses at undergraduate, postgraduate, and diploma levels. Candidates will have the option to select a course from a wide variety of streams such as management, Engineering, Law, Architecture, Pharmacy, and Computer Applications. Most of the AGI courses are approved by AICTE and offered in affiliation with AKTU.

admission_process.title: Accurate Group of Institutions Admission Process 2025

paragraphs: Accurate Group of Institutions admission processis online. The step-wiseAGI admission processis given below:
1- Registration Process 2025

Contenders must register themselves with the institute in order to apply for admission. The application forms are released on the official website of the Accurate Group of Institutes. Students have to register using a valid email ID and phone number. It must be filled out carefully by the candidate before the last date.
2- Selection Criteria
Students selection based on their performance on the entrance exam. Contenders have to upload valid scorecards during the application process.
3- Admission call and confirmation of seat
If they clear all the criteria, they are selected and informed via email or call. Shortlisted students are required to pay the admission confirmation fee to book their seats.

reviews_list.review_title: It is the best course for students who are aspiring a career in research.

review_content.Placements: PGPMR from Northpoint Centre of Learning is a collaborated programme with Nielsen. Students who have successfully completed this programme will be placed in Nielsen. All the students from our batch have got the job, and 90% of them got placed in Nielsen for the research executive role. The top performer from the batch has received the offer from PepsiCo in the CMI team. The salary package offered was 7 LPA and above for all the placed students. Regarding the internships, all the students have done two internships with Nielsen, one with the leading FMCG Manufacturers, i.e., clients of Nielsen and a rural internship. content.Placements: Almost 90% of the students were placed post completion of the course. There is a library with all marketing, strategy and advertising related books for students to refer to.

review_summary.college_name: DTU East Delhi Campus Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Business Administration (B.B.A.) - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: It is a good college with good faculty members.

content.Placements: The average package offered is around 5 LPA. Top recruiting companies for our course include KPMG, JP Morgan, Yes Bank, Britannia, etc. The college also provides students with internships. Placements are good in regard to it being a new business school. It's still growing.
content.Infrastructure: Facilities available are really great. We have centralised ACs and centralised heaters in every classroom. We have access to Wi-Fi, and there is a library too. There is no hostel, but various PGs and flats are available near the college. There is Nescafé, and we all crave for their Maggie.

individual_reviews.course: B.A. (Hons.) in Economics - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: There is a difficult course curriculum for Economics Honours.

content.Placements: About 50 percent of students get placed. The highest package offered is 12 LPA. The lowest package offered is 3 LPA. The average package offered is 8 LPA. Top companies like Accenture, Deloitte, KPMG, and Tata hire students. About 90 percent of students get internships from on-campus internship fairs in various companies, mostly small brands and businesses. Students also get placed as founder's office interns and as social media managers. The top role offered in my course is a data analyst, as data science is a minor degree in our course.
content.Infrastructure: Facilities are top-notch. Projectors and Wi-Fi are good for computers in labs. There are the latest computer models in labs. Classrooms are clean and well-equipped. The library has a huge number of copies of every book that is prescribed. It has a well-managed and friendly space for work. Hostels are not available. There is no mess or canteen. The canteen reopens often when someone buys a tender, and only to face loss. Only one badminton court and a volleyball court are available. Medical facilities are good. We also get facilities like first aid and medicines.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Business Administration (B.B.A.) - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: The college has a great crowd and good exposure.

content.Placements: Placements are decent but mostly average. Around 40-50 percent of students get placed. The average package ranges from 3-4 LPA, and the highest package ranges from 8-10 LPA. The lowest package ranges between 2 LPA. Top recruiting companies include consulting firms, startups, banks, etc. A good number of students secure internships in marketing, finance, HR, and business development fields.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is great. Classrooms are well-maintained and equipped with projectors and good Wi-Fi. The library provides good academic resources. Computer labs are functional. Medical room and sports facilities for volleyball, basketball, and table tennis are also available.

individual_reviews.course: B.A. (Hons.) in Economics - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: It has a good crowd with great exposure and facilities.

content.Placements: The highest package offered is 12 LPA. The average package ranges from 5-6 LPA, and the lowest package offered is around 3 LPA. Almost 50 percent of students get placed in this course. Top companies like EY, Deloitte, TCS, Wipro, Accenture, KPMG, etc., visit the college for placements. Almost 90 percent of students got internships in consulting, research companies, and startups.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure and facilities are good. There is good Wi-Fi connectivity. Classrooms are spacious and maintained. Labs and the library are also nice and have good resources. Indoor and outdoor sports facilities and areas are also available. A medical room is also there.

individual_reviews.course: B.A. (Hons.) in Economics - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Honest college review: My college life and how I view my college.

content.Placements: I don't know about placements yet, but I have heard someone from the campus has secured a more than 50 LPA in one of the Big Four companies. Otherwise, you would have to join societies and clubs and maintain a good CGPA to land in one of the great companies.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is top-notch, really amazing. It's small but worth it. I really enjoy being around the campus. The cafeteria, the volleyball court, the badminton court, the basketball court, and the cricket pitch are all well organised and maintained. The campus is very clean.

admission_process.title: ISAB Admission Process 2025

paragraphs: Currently, admissions are open at ISAB for the 2025 session. Candidates meeting the eligibility criteria can apply for the preferred course. The school offers admission to candidates based on their entrance test scores. ISAB also conducts other selection rounds to select candidates for admission. Below are the steps to get a seat in the school:
Step 1: ISAB Application Process 2025

The mode of application is online. Aspirants can fill out the application form for the preferred course on the school's website. Candidates have to pay an application fee of INR 650 for the MBA and PGP courses.
Step 2: Entrance Exam

Candidates can get admission in MBA programme based on their CAT, XAT, CMAT or GMAT scores. Aspirants without any of the accepted scores can appear for the ISAB Online Aptitude Test conducted by the school. ISA'BEST scores are also valid for admission to the PGP programme. For the Specialised Management Programme, candidates are selected based on their profile, interest and performance during the Personal Interaction round.
Step 3: Admission Confirmation

ISAB informs the candidates about their selection after the release of ISA'BEST. Selected candidates need to report at the campus for document verification. Aspirants also need to pay theISAB feeto confirm their seat.

faqs.answer: ISAB offers admission to courses based on entrance exam scores of the candidates. Aspirants have to pass ISA'BEST conducted by the school for admission. Aspirants can also get admission in the MBA programme based on their CAT, XAT, CMAT or GMAT scores. Students with percentile above 75 in CAT or CMAT are exempted from appearing for ISAB Online Aptitude Test and are directly eligible for next round of selection process i.e. GDPI. faqs.question: Does ISAB conduct entrance exam for admission?

hostel_campus.college_name: ISAB Greater Noida Infrastructure Details & Reviews

hostel.description:
At ISAB, we believe that the hostel plays an important role in a student's academic and social adjustment to the Institute. Thus, we have taken extra care to ensure that you get conducive environment and good amenities in the confines of your hostel. The selfsustained & sprawling Hostel campus offers room on double and triple occupancy basis depending on the individual needs.

The hostel offers you:
• Bedroom equipped with individual bed, study table with chair and almirah for each student
• Attached bathroom fitted with centralized hot water boiler, & other amenities
• Air-condition or cooler provision for that unmatched comfort
• Attached balcony where you can sip your morning cup of tea or milk
• Free Wi-Fi connection for you to be connected with the world around you
• Power back up for uninterrupted comfortable experience
• Free Laundry Facility
• Ample free parking area where you can park your own vehicle
• Music Room for recreational activities

Guest Room- Hostel guest room can be availed by the parents for not more than 2 days at a nominal cost as per availability.

Sport Amenities:
i) Indoor games choices would include: Table Tennis, Carom etc.
Outdoor games options would include: Basketball, Volleyball, Badminton etc.
Security is of paramount importance at ISAB, hence we have made sure that you are protected with 24/7 patrolling of the premises by the guards and CCTV camera surveillance of the entire premises.

individual_reviews.course: Post Graduate Diploma in Management (PGDM) - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: The college is absolutely good.

content.Placements: Average placements are not so exceptional. The highest package offered was INR 18.55 LPA; till now, the lowest package is INR 9 LPA, as the placements are still in progress. The placement has been good since last year too; the willing students got placement, some early and some a bit late.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure-wise, the colleges have nothing, as shown in multiple visuals. The Wi-Fi is not for the students, and it is also very slow. The labs are either filled with dust or those 19th-century computers that stop working every now and then. The classrooms are spacious but have comfortable seats.

individual_reviews.course: Post Graduate Diploma in Management (PGDM) - Batch of 2021
individual_reviews.title: Review of ASM - Apeejay School of Management.

content.Placements: Around 70% of the students got placed now. The salary package offered ranges between 5-19.5 LPA after the completion of the course. Top recruiters of our college for PGDM finance are Deloitte, EY, NoPaperForms, ICICI, Kotak Mahindra Bank, ITC, Umeed Housing Finance and Edelweiss. Internship opportunities are also available in companies like WNS Global, ITC, Decathlon, etc., with an 80-90% success rate. Top roles offered in our specialisation are analyst, financial analyst, executive trainee finance and deputy manager.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is average, but the quality of education is second to none. Classrooms are well-equipped with Wi-Fi, and classrooms have a smart projector system. Computer labs are well-connected with fast internet services. The food provided in the canteen is like any other B-school in Delhi.

individual_reviews.course: Post Graduate Diploma in Management (PGDM) - Batch of 2021
individual_reviews.title: The college is average not dissatisfied.

content.Placements: The percentage of students were placed is almost 70%. The highest and the lowest package offered by the companies are 5 lacs to 19 lacs. Top recruiting companies are Amazon. As far as internship thing there was around 70% of students got internship and college also provide live projects for the exposure.
content.Infrastructure: College has Wi-Fi facility but not for students only faculty can access. There are computer labs and library available for students till college timings. Hostel facility is available the food was average. There is no proper medical room available in the college.

individual_reviews.course: Post Graduate Diploma in Management (PGDM) - Batch of 2014
individual_reviews.title: A good college with nice placement record.

content.Placements: Around 90% of the students were placed. Many companies like Yes bank, Pepsi come to the campus. Around 50% of students got internship. College provides good opportunities to students and it depends on how you can grab it. There are manager roles offered to students .
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is good. The labs and library are nice too. I was not part of hostel so can't tell anything about it but I heard it's good. The canteen was average. The sport and medical facilities available were also nice.

individual_reviews.course: Post Graduate Diploma in Management (PGDM) - Batch of 2020
individual_reviews.title: ASM is one of the best B-schools in Delhi.

content.Placements: From the 2020 batch, most of the students get placed already, and the remaining students are still getting opportunities in this pandemic scenario. Major recruiters are from marketing specialisation, and the rest are also good. Some top recruiting companies like Amazon, HSBC, Airtel, etc., visit our college for placements.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of our college is good, but it lacks ground on the campus due to which students get to involve more into studies. The canteen is decent. Our college also provides classroom and libraries. The hostel facility is not available for students.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, best college for an MBA.
reviews.review_text: College campus is great. Classrooms are good and clean. Also, labs, an auditorium, and a library are present with a variety of books. College arranges an enjoyable fest for students. Hostel rooms are average to good at only 1.49 Lacs for two years. Mess food is delicious.

reviews.review_heading: Our college provides numerous workshops to equip students for successful careers.
reviews.review_text: Facilities in our college are very good. Our college boasts a central hub, and SMART classrooms are available. There's a large library with good books and study materials. The canteen is very good and serves good food. Our laboratory facilities are very nice, and free Wi-Fi is available. Finally, our college has an excellent athletic department, supported by experienced coaches and a gymnasium.

reviews.review_heading: The college is pretty satisfactory but can improve in terms of education and hostel facilities.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is pretty decent. There is greenery all over. It's not that huge, so everyone goes to the PU side for everything. The food in the canteen is pretty good, but the hostel is not that good. The food and facilities there are not good, and many people left in the first year because of these issues.

reviews.review_heading: College is very good, with excellent faculty and great support for students.
reviews.review_text: Facility was top-notch. The campus was spread over a total of thirteen acres, and it has PU (Pre-University) and a school on the same campus. St. Claret has high-tech classrooms, very well maintained, and a superb environment. The hostel is for only 1 year, after 1 year, the student finds their living place by themselves, and there's great support for sports.

reviews.review_heading: The library has such a wonderful collection of books.
reviews.review_text: The hostel facilities at the college are not that great. Considering the quality of food and room they provide, the prices are too high. The food menu typically includes just price per chapatti, and sometimes egg curry or sambar. The rooms are small. Registration was easy, and the cost of one room can vary from Rs. 6,000 to Rs. 7,500. This college and hostel are located in Jalahalli Village. There are PGs and rented apartments nearby.

reviews.review_heading: My best experience in this college.
reviews.review_text: As per the educational course trends, ACCA is kind of moving well and has a good career option for students interested in finance and have an idea of joining the bank. The college collaborated with many international colleges other than India which is helpful for us to communicate with the people who come visit our college in their free time. There are three hostels provided by the college. Two are girls hostel and one is boys hostel. Girls hostel is okay, the food is fine, and the environment i...

reviews.review_heading: The quality of teachers. They are very friendly, and lectures are easy to understand.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure was spacious and aesthetic, and my favorite place was the library. It had a great collection of books.

reviews.review_heading: Faculty are very friendly and helpful.
reviews.review_text: There were a variety of books available in the library. Classrooms were equipped with Smartboards, and there was a focus on students' physical fitness also.

reviews.review_heading: I like the library facility where they provide a lot of books academics as well as novels.
reviews.review_text: The best part that I enjoy in claret is the fest be it Mayuri, udbhav, sparkle night, etc. There are plenty of festivals happening in our college. The accessibility of books is quite disappointing coz a lot of times I never got the books when I visited the library.

reviews.review_heading: Thank you for the good placements, and I am satisfied because of the faculty.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure available for our course were good and great. Wi-Fi, labs, and classrooms were well-maintained and clean for students. The library was maintained well. The quality of the facilities in our hostel, the food available in the mess and canteen, and the medical facilities.

reviews.review_heading: My experience at this college.
reviews.review_text: The boys' hostel had a limited number of vacancies, and the living conditions were not that good. However, the girls' hostel seemed okay. The food was good, tasty, and had variety, which was a positive aspect. However, it could always improve.

reviews.review_heading: Great college if your are looking for affordable and great teaching in holistic way.
reviews.review_text: The facilities are impressive except for Wi-Fi. They provide LAN facilities in libraries and labs but not in classrooms. And also there is a Wi-Fi facility in the canteen which most of us don't use. The classrooms are big and we'll maintain and so is the campus there is green everywhere even though it's not that big campus it is refreshing. Our department has labs and they provide free laptops for our course which is great use. And if you use it in a good way they will last longer than the degre...

reviews.review_heading: I am absolutely satisfied because of the faculty members, good placements, and good infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is awesome. The library books are awesome. It has novels and we get different types of books for different perspectives. Faculty members in the hostel are good because they provide us with good and clean rooms. I have awesome roommates in the hostel, but the only disadvantage is the food.

reviews.review_heading: I am proud to be a student of St. Claret College.
reviews.review_text: Hostel rooms and also food will be provided by the college. For hostel students, we have a canteen where you can buy 24x 7 hours. There is Wi-Fi, but it is available only near the canteen. The library has different types of books and exam materials. It also has a gym.

reviews.review_heading: St. Claret College, Bangalore.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure of the college is so good with a nice ambiance. There is library, labs, classroom, free Wi-Fi, etc., are available. The college provides 3 hostels 2 for girls and one for boys. Hostel also provides mess. The food is also good. The college provides sports and games for students.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Computer Application (BCA) - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: I am absolutely satisfied with all facilities provided by the IITM, Janakpuri.

content.Placements: Placements are very good. Around 95% of students got placed last year. The highest package is 22 LPA. Last year, the top recruiting company was Cisco. 90% of students got internship offers in many different companies like Cisco, Walmart, Dhirati Education, etc. Top roles offered are software engineer, networking, web developer, system engineer, etc.
content.Infrastructure: IITM, Janakpuri has all facilities like Wi-Fi-enabled campus, pure and safe drinking water, a library, 12 labs with the latest configuration computers, and fully AC classrooms. The food cart is also very good. Sports are very nice. All types of sports are available here.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Computer Application (BCA) - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Dedicated and supportive faculty members.

content.Placements: The placement cell is active and works consistently to connect students with potential recruiters. Companies like Wipro, Google, Decathlon, Infosys, etc., have visited the campus for recruitment drives. The average package offered by the college is 3 LPA - 4.5 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: The classrooms are clean, spacious, and equipped with projectors. We have smartboards that provide a tech-enabled learning environment. The computer systems in the lab are well-updated. It provides high-speed Wi-Fi support to all the students, enabling students to access online resources conveniently.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Computer Application (BCA) - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Satisfied with teachers, academics, college life. Not satisfied with placement and infrastructure.

content.Placements: 60-70% or even less are placed in the course I have admitted. The lowest package is around 3 LPA, the highest package is around 4.5 LPA, and the average is 3.5 LPA. Companies like TCS, Wipro, and Infosys are the main recruiters, and then startups. Not a lot idea about the internship, but it isn't a lot. Most students had to look for internships outside the campus. Roles as Software Developer, Frontend Developer, AI related roles.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is just okay, not a big campus, and also not a lot of sitting and playing area. Just a building block. The library, labs, and classroom are good, but you won't get Wi-Fi, so don't get your hope high. No hostel, so nothing related to that. The canteen is good, there are a few stalls of fast food, Nestlé, and all, so that works alright.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Computer Application (BCA) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: In our college, all things are very nice. Facilities are good.

content.Placements: A minimum of 60% of students get placed. The highest package is 12 LPA. Top recruiting companies for our course are Infosys and Wipro. To get internships, students have to get a minimum of 60% and also have some knowledge about the job. We also have to know what kind of questions are asked in the interview.
content.Faculty: Semester exams are not hard, but when we learn things. Teachers are very helpful, and we can go and ask our problems. They help us to solve our problems. They always help us in every situation. Faculty members are very good in nature. They are understanding and all are well-educated. They provide each note and assignment. They take regular tests and provide PPTs. They also help us to grow up and they give us more energy to do something for us.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Computer Application (BCA) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Satisfactory college journey.

content.Placements: The IITM, Janakpuri is a college affiliated with GGSIPU. The students and faculty members are well-managed. The student with a percentage above 80% is recommended to join the institute. Recently, for batch 2022-2025 companies like CISCO, Wipro, TCS, and Deloitte are the top companies that hire freshers. The average package ranges from 3LPA to 13 LPA in our college as of now. As per the current norms, BCA degree has been extended to 4 years only if any student wants an honors degree. Many recently emerging technologies like IoT, AI/ML, and data science are now part of the curriculum. I managed to grab my placement opportunity at Jaro Education, offering me the job role of data analyst. The average package is 3.28 LPA which is quite a good start for my journey.

paragraphs: One School of Business admissionsare both merit and entrance-based. The school considers scores in national-level entrance exams such as CAT, MAT and XAT. One School of Business offers courses at UG, PG and PhD courses. Besides, the school also offers certificate programmes.One School of Businessoffers courses in affiliation withBangalore North University. Interested candidates can apply online for admission.

The school offers admission to PG courses based on entrance exam scores. Candidates are selected for UG courses based on their qualifying exam scores. Aspirants must fulfil the eligibility requirements to apply for admission. Below are the topOne School of Business coursesalong with their eligibility and selection criteria:
Admissions are currently open for all the OSB courses. Candidates must meet the eligibility criteria to apply for the preferred programme. Below are the steps to get a seat in the school:
Step 1: One School of Business Application Process 2025

Candidates can apply online for admission. Aspirants must first register with basic details to generate login credentials. Candidates then need to fill out the application form by paying an application fee.
Step 2: Selection

Aspirants are selected for admission to PG courses based on their score in the entrance exam. Candidates must have a valid score in CAT, MAT or XAT for admission to MBA. For UG courses, admission is based on the merit of the aspirants in the qualifying exam. Candidates selected for the MBA course are further called for a personal interview round.
Step 3: Merit List & Admission Status
The school releases a merit list with the names of the selected candidates. Aspirants have to pay a registration amount within the given time, failing which the offer is considered cancelled.
Step 4: Selection Letter
Upon selection, aspirants receive an acceptance letter. Candidates need to submit the specified document verification and pay the first instalment of the fee to confirm their seat.

review_summary.college_name: Sri Ramakrishna Engineering College Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Really good facilities, infrastructure, and good placements in 2025.

content.Placements: 95% students are placed in my course. The highest package is likely to be 55 LPA for my course, the average package is 20 LPA, and the lowest package is above 7 LPA. The top recruiting company for my course is Capgemini. 85% students got internships in the same company, Capgemini. The top roles offered in my course are Software Developer.
content.Infrastructure: For CSE, we have Wi-Fi facilities in all labs. We have nearly 10 labs specially for CSE, and good library facilities are also available online, to get books anywhere. The hostel facilities are good. Some of my hostel friends told me that there are some drinking water issues, but other things are good. Our college has a food court on campus, and the food is good, no complaints. Our college trustee has their own hospital, so the medical facilities are good in our college and sports and games are good.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: This college is the safest plan B for any student.

content.Placements: 75% of students got placed. The highest package is 20 LPA, the lowest package is 2 LPA. Capgemini, Accenture, and TCS are the top recruiting companies, but getting a placement is easy. However, the company has told the students that they are not capable enough, and more than 60% of students have been fired within one year.
content.Infrastructure: The library is good. Wi-Fi is provided at selected locations. The hostel is below average with very high fees. Facilities like mess, canteen, medical facilities, sports, and games are good, but you need to find time to utilize these facilities, and the gym is also available, but the equipment is very average.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: It has good faculty members with PhD. It has helpful teaching and average placements.

content.Placements: Mostly 72-75% of students got placed in the college. The highest package is 12 LPA and the lowest package is 3.5 LPA. A lot of companies visit our campus like Cognizant, Kovai. Co, Accenture. etc. This time, only 78% of students of students get placed. A lot of seniors passed from the college and got placed in good companies and also higher companies like Amazon, Flipkart, etc.
content.Infrastructure: The hostel is okay and the food is not good. Students are not satisfied with the college. The food available in the canteen is not that much of good.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: Overall, it is the best college for the MBA course.

content.Placements: Approximately 82-92% of students participated in this study. The highest package is 29 LPA, the average is around 15-22 LPA, and the lowest is 3-6 LPA. Top recruiters are Flipkart, Snapdeal, Larsen & Toubro, etc. 70-80% of students get internships in many industries. The top jobs offered are financial analyst, operations manager, and more.
content.Infrastructure: The college has well-equipped labs available for all branches. You have to pay for Wi-Fi, as it is not available for students. There are three libraries with all the books, and an excellent cafeteria where students can treat themselves to all kinds of good food. The college provides a bus service, and it plies all over Coimbatore and some places outside Coimbatore.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: It is the best college for placements.

content.Placements: The top engineering school in Coimbatore was Sri Ramakrishna Engineering College. This college had excellent placement results. In my last year, around 30 firms came to interview on this college campus. The wage packages given by such companies range from 4 LPA to 15 LPA. These interviews on college campuses resulted in placements for almost 97% of students. Well-known businesses include Teach Mahendra, TVS, Hyundai, and TCS. These businesses came to interview on this college campus.
content.Infrastructure: The amenities and infrastructure of Sri Ramakrishna Engineering College were first-rate. This college also has a well-stocked library and more contemporary labs and classrooms. Good hostel amenities were offered by this college. There is a wide selection of cuisine at this campus canteen. There were also other sports facilities on this campus. Traveling was made easier for us by the excellent transmission options this college offered its students. This college also had Wi-Fi facilities.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Good learning environment with helpful teachers and an active campus.

content.Placements: I completed my BBA from NSHM Durgapur, and overall, experience was decent. Our batch, around 65 to 70 percent of students, got placed. Highest package offered was nearly 6 LPA, lowest was about 2.5 LPA and average package came to around 3.5 LPA. Top recruiters included Deloitte, Wipro, TCS, HDFC Bank and a few good startups. Around 60 percent of students also managed to get internships in companies like ICICI, Reliance and other reputed organizations.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure for BBA course at NSHM Durgapur is good. Classrooms are spacious, well-furnished and have smart boards with proper ventilation. Campus has good Wi-Fi connectivity, a well-stocked library and seminar halls for presentations. Though it's a management course, there are computer labs for projects and online work. Hostel facilities are decent with clean rooms, regular water supply and basic furnishings. Mess food is average with a mix of vegetarian and non-vegetarian options and canteen has affordable snacks. Medical facilities are available on campus. There is space for indoor games and a ground for outdoor sports.

individual_reviews.title: Best college for BBA in Durgapur.

Students received an average package of 2-3 LPA, while the highest package, as far as I know, is between 5-6 LPA. 95% of students secured internships through the college.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is good. The classrooms are spacious, and the desks are of good quality. We have projectors in every class for digital learning, and Wi-Fi is available to everyone on campus. All the labs are fully air-conditioned, and the hostel is also suitable for students coming from far away from home. Indoor games and a gym facility are also available.

reviews.review_heading: Good learning environment with helpful teachers and an active campus.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure for BBA course at NSHM Durgapur is good. Classrooms are spacious, well-furnished and have smart boards with proper ventilation. Campus has good Wi-Fi connectivity, a well-stocked library and seminar halls for presentations. Though it's a management course, there are computer labs for projects and online work. Hostel facilities are decent with clean rooms, regular water supply and basic furnishings. Mess food is average with a mix of vegetarian and non-vegetarian options and cantee...

reviews.review_heading: Best college for BBA in Durgapur.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is good. The classrooms are spacious, and the desks are of good quality. We have projectors in every class for digital learning, and Wi-Fi is available to everyone on campus. All the labs are fully air-conditioned, and the hostel is also suitable for students coming from far away from home. Indoor games and a gym facility are also available.

reviews.review_heading: Review of NSHM Business School, Durgapur.
reviews.review_text: The campus provides free Wi-Fi to all the students, I'm not a hosteler but my friends in the hostel are getting every facility with good meals. There's a canteen for day scholar students for lunch, a cafeteria for gossip, and a sports complex for different games and sports.

reviews.review_heading: NSHM College Durgapur: A leading hub for professional and technical education.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are not that good but we get clean and hygienic rooms every day. We also get a Wi-Fi connection. Hostel students get a canteen card and a gym card. Labs are more advanced for B.Tech students which helps them to perform well in their work. The library is full of books which helps students sit, read, and gain more.

reviews.review_heading: NSHM - An Unbiased Review.
reviews.review_text: I have been staying in the hostel, and the hostel facilities are way too good. I have never seen this type of hostel at a very low price. They provide good food, full Wi-Fi connections, labs, and a good library. There are many printed books and journals. The quality of facilities in the hostel is way too high, which other colleges cannot afford at this time. Every year, we have an annual sports competition, and an inter-college sports competition, which includes both indoor and outdoor games.

reviews.review_heading: Moderate college as per the fee.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is good, but the computers are not. There is no good computer in the college for practical. There are sports complexes and gyms for both girls and boys but they are used at different times of the day. There is no fear of ragging inside the college. The mess food is good, but sometimes they ruin it.

reviews.review_heading: Good college for your jobs.
reviews.review_text: The college provides access to high-speed internet connectivity on campus. Classrooms: The college has multimedia-enhanced classrooms with acoustics designed for interactivity. Library: The college library has a reading room, computers, and reprography facilities. The library also offers access to journals, books, and previous year question papers. Seminar Libraries: Each department has its own seminar library.

reviews.review_heading: A review of campus life as a student at NSHM Knowledge Campus, Durgapur.
reviews.review_text: All the required infrastructures were available to us, like Wi-Fi connectivity all around the campus for all the students with around 30Mbps speed, smart board-equipped classrooms, and a massive computer lab with around 100+ computers with cross-connectivity among them, meaning no matter which computer you get, you will have access to your last work by logging through the firewall. A library with vast amount of books and also an online portal to access the books on the go. The food available is ...

reviews.review_heading: Good for placement to kickstart your career.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure was good, with comfortable classrooms, labs, and a library as well. The mess food is good, healthy, and hygienic. They also provide medical facilities if you are sick. They have a very good sports ground and gaming rooms to enjoy.

reviews.review_heading: NSHM Knowledge Campus Durgapur: The best way of learning with job security.
reviews.review_text: The college features a big cafeteria, a sports complex indoors and outdoors, and 2 large libraries. All classrooms are now Wi-Fi connected. Speaking of hostels, students get sharing rooms in the hostel. There's also one canteen, and the food quality is good.

reviews.review_heading: Really good infrastructure and expecting good placement in the future.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is the best in Durgapur and quite developed; it has good teachers and students; the staff is good and well-cared for; they take care of everyone in the college and are very well-behaved; and the college guards are well-spoken and good people.

reviews.review_heading: The best college in Eastern India.
reviews.review_text: The NSHM Durgapur Campus has an area of 35 acres. On this beautiful campus, we have two libraries, AI labs, basic computer labs, advanced engineering labs, and most specifically, the greenery out here. We have a playground, an indoor game complex, a yoga room, etc. There are two separate hostels for boys and girls.

reviews.review_heading: Placements in MNCs, Beautiful Lush Green Campus, Unique Cultural Fest.
reviews.review_text: While not all classrooms have air conditioning, all labs are equipped with it. The library is well-maintained, and the book-issuing system is strict. Campus-wide Wi-Fi with good speed is available. The hostel facilities include an indoor gym, outdoor sports field, mess, and canteen. The canteen serves hygienic food, and the token system is used for outsiders, while hostellers pay directly.

reviews.review_heading: Nshm business school campus is great.
reviews.review_text: Yes, there was free Wi-Fi in canteen areas, and the classrooms are quiet good. The library is a very big place where you can find any kind of course-related book. Yes, the quality of the food is very good. And also, sports and medical facilities are quite good.

reviews.review_heading: This college provides average faculty members and placements are good.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure and facilities are good. Wi-Fi is slow, and laboratories are average. Classrooms are fine, and it also provides a good library. The hostel is very expensive, and the food served in the mess and canteen is good. Medical facilities are good, but the rent is expensive.

admission_process.title: Amrut Mody School of Management Admission Process 2026

paragraphs: AMSOM admissionsare both merit and entrance-based. Aspirants need to fulfil the minimum eligibility and appear for the respective entrance exams for specific courses. The final selection is done based on the merit lists released by the institute. Find below the step-by-step admission process for AMSOM:
STEP 1: Amrut Mody School of Management Application Process 2026

Amrut Mody School of Management application process is conducted in online mode. Candidates can apply on the official website with an application fee of INR 1,200 for MBA and MS programmes. Aspirants also need to upload specified documents during the application process.
STEP 2: Selection

Amrut Mody School of Management shortlists candidates for MBA programme based on national or university-level Management entrance exams such as CAT, MAT, XAT, CMAT, NMAT. Admission to UG courses are based on merit in the last qualifying exam. AMSOM conducts AMSOM PG Aptitude Test for MS programmes. Candidates with any of the accepted entrance exams can also apply for MS programmes. Selected candidates also need to pass the personal interview round for final admission.
STEP 3: Admission Confirmation
Once the selection rounds are completed, admission offers are made to the eligible candidates. Selected aspirants need to pay the AMSOM fees to confirm their seat in the school.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2029
reviews_list.review_title: It has a big green campus with good classrooms. Placements are good.

review_content.Placements: The placement record of NIT Jalandhar is good. Approximately 90% of eligible students got placed. The top recruiting companies are Amazon and Google. More than half of the students got internships in top companies. Roles offered are as a web developer, cloud manager, and cybersecurity engineer.
review_content.Infrastructure: There is a separate building for the CSE branch in the college. Many options are available in the college for food and snacks if you do not enjoy the hostel meal. The buildings are new, well-maintained, and contain lifts. For every course, there are separate labs, and the instruments in the labs are new. There is a slight problem that the hostel rooms for two are very small, but every room contains a balcony, and the view from the balcony is good. The food in the hostel is average. Sometimes it is very good, and sometimes it is okay.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Industrial and Production Engineering - Batch of 2029
reviews_list.review_title: The placements are getting better year by year. The college life is also awesome.

review_content.Placements: The placement percentage is 100 percent for the eligible students, however, the numbers are not that good. The highest placement package on campus is 18 LPA for the branch Industrial and Production Engineering. The lowest package is 4 LPA, and the average is 8–9 LPA. The top recruiting company is Trident. The top roles that are offered are basically in the research and development department, but one can also excel in other fields by having good knowledge and practice for that particular field.
review_content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of our college is awesome, simply mind-blowing. There are no issues regarding the infrastructure of classrooms, library, etc. However, the infrastructure of hostels for first-year students is not that good. The hostels are very basic, they provide one bed and a chair-table for one person and a cupboard/almirah for clothes. The quality of food is decent; the chapattis are very bad to eat, but the other items and menu rotation are good. The canteen of our college is average, not great in taste, however, Domino’s and Nescafe provide great taste and quality of food.

content.Placements: The placement record of NIT Jalandhar is good. Approximately 90% of eligible students got placed. The top recruiting companies are Amazon and Google. More than half of the students got internships in top companies. Roles offered are as a web developer, cloud manager, and cybersecurity engineer.
content.Infrastructure: There is a separate building for the CSE branch in the college. Many options are available in the college for food and snacks if you do not enjoy the hostel meal. The buildings are new, well-maintained, and contain lifts. For every course, there are separate labs, and the instruments in the labs are new. There is a slight problem that the hostel rooms for two are very small, but every room contains a balcony, and the view from the balcony is good. The food in the hostel is average. Sometimes it is very good, and sometimes it is okay.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Industrial and Production Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: The placements are getting better year by year. The college life is also awesome.

content.Placements: The placement percentage is 100 percent for the eligible students, however, the numbers are not that good. The highest placement package on campus is 18 LPA for the branch Industrial and Production Engineering. The lowest package is 4 LPA, and the average is 8–9 LPA. The top recruiting company is Trident. The top roles that are offered are basically in the research and development department, but one can also excel in other fields by having good knowledge and practice for that particular field.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of our college is awesome, simply mind-blowing. There are no issues regarding the infrastructure of classrooms, library, etc. However, the infrastructure of hostels for first-year students is not that good. The hostels are very basic, they provide one bed and a chair-table for one person and a cupboard/almirah for clothes. The quality of food is decent; the chapattis are very bad to eat, but the other items and menu rotation are good. The canteen of our college is average, not great in taste, however, Domino’s and Nescafe provide great taste and quality of food.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Core placements are not satisfying, but everything else is top notch. Sports and cultural.

content.Placements: Placements in the civil department are not very good. You receive fewer core opportunities on campus, but there is scope in non-core roles. People do get placed. The average package is 7.5 LPA, and the highest goes up to 20 LPA, which is in tech. You have to prepare for placements yourself. The college curriculum does not help much here.
content.Infrastructure: The department building has all the facilities needed. You can reach out to any faculty member for help, as they are really friendly. Hostels are decent, and the mess food is good enough. First-year hostels have a badminton court and a volleyball court. There are three boys’ hostels and two girls’ hostels for first-year students.

admission_process.title: NIT Jalandhar Admission Process 2025

paragraphs: NIT Jalandhar admission process 2025is based on entrance exam scores of the candidates. The institute offers UG, PG, and PhD level courses. NITJ also offers PG Diploma courses in Management and Engineering.NIT Jalandharconsiders scores innational-level entrance exams such as JEE Main, GATE, NIMCET, CAT, etc. The application process is conducted in an online mode on the official website of the respective entrance exams.

NIT Jalandhar admission processincludes the application process, selection round, cutoff, merit list, and counselling. Check below the steps to get admission Dr B R Ambedkar National Institute of Technology, Jalandhar:
1: NIT Jalandhar Application Process

Candidates seeking admission at NIT Jalandhar are required to complete the application form for the course-specific entrance exam. After appearing for the respective entrance exams, candidates have to apply for the counselling process for the final seat allotment. However, candidates seeking admission to PhD courses are through the official website.
2: Selection Rounds

For its flagship BTech course, NIT Jalandhar admits students with a valid JEE Main score. Candidates are allotted seats throughJoSAA Counselling. Admission to MTech is through GATE, followed by CCMT Counselling. Similarly for MSc admission, IIT JAM and CCMN Counselling are required. However, NIT Jalandhar MBA admissions are done through CAT score, where the shortlisted candidates have to appear for the Personal Interview round.
3: Release of Cutoff list, Counselling & Admission Confirmation

NIT Jalandhar cutofffor BTech, MTech and MSc courses is released by the respective counselling bodies. Whereas, for MBA admission, the institute releases direct merit lists after declaring the final results of all rounds. The shortlisted candidates are then required to pay the admission fee to confirm their seats.

NIT Jalandhar fees for all UG & PG courses include components such as tuition fees, hostel fees, and one-time fee payments. Coming to affordability is one of the causes why many students leave a degree or a college. reviews.review_heading: Not the best placements (but in rate it's 100 percent in my branch) but a very good college.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is the best thing in the college. Every day I go to my college from hostel and see all the buildings and so much luxurious classrooms, my heart fills with happiness that I'm at a very best place for 4 years of my graduation. The surroundings are clean and there are little extreme climate conditions though.

reviews.review_heading: College has really good placement and infrastructure. Even the behaviour of staff is good.
reviews.review_text: If we talk about the infrastructure, the infrastructure is quite good. The campus is spread in 152 acres. Each department has its own building. Classrooms are good but there are some old classrooms as well. But each classroom is filled with facilities like projector, AC, even some new classrooms have digital boards and Television. If we talk about Hostel, each hostel has different management. Hostel infrastructure is decent with decent food quality. Campus also has a dispensary and ambulance for...

reviews.review_heading: It has a big green campus with good classrooms. Placements are good.
reviews.review_text: There is a separate building for the CSE branch in the college. Many options are available in the college for food and snacks if you do not enjoy the hostel meal. The buildings are new, well-maintained, and contain lifts. For every course, there are separate labs, and the instruments in the labs are new. There is a slight problem that the hostel rooms for two are very small, but every room contains a balcony, and the view from the balcony is good. The food in the hostel is average. Sometimes it ...

reviews.review_heading: The placements are getting better year by year. The college life is also awesome.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is awesome, simply mind-blowing. There are no issues regarding the infrastructure of classrooms, library, etc. However, the infrastructure of hostels for first-year students is not that good. The hostels are very basic, they provide one bed and a chair-table for one person and a cupboard/almirah for clothes. The quality of food is decent; the chapattis are very bad to eat, but the other items and menu rotation are good. The canteen of our college is average, not...

reviews.review_heading: Core placements are not satisfying, but everything else is top notch. Sports and cultural.
reviews.review_text: The department building has all the facilities needed. You can reach out to any faculty member for help, as they are really friendly. Hostels are decent, and the mess food is good enough. First-year hostels have a badminton court and a volleyball court. There are three boys’ hostels and two girls’ hostels for first-year students.

reviews.review_heading: Best college ever in all types.
reviews.review_text: Good infrastructure in labs, library, garden, and classroom. Food is best quality, all other is average in our hostel. Cleanliness is average level. Hostel attendees are not good, they always blame students for anything that happens in the hostel. The garden is not for students, only for attendees.

reviews.review_heading: Faculty is average, placements are going up, and infrastructure and facilities are good for the cost
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is good in my opinion. The classes are well-equipped with projectors and smart boards. Its one of the benefits of government institutes. There's Wi-Fi everywhere on campus. The library is also newly made and very comfortable. The hostel we got in our first year is actually very good. The food is actually good, and everything else is too, the facilities for outdoor and indoor games are enough, there's a computer room with high end PC's. There's only one downside to this, that w...

reviews.review_heading: The college is too beautiful and good in everything.
reviews.review_text: The Wi-Fi facility is not good. Hostel, all facilities are good. Mess food is good, and all services in the mess are good. Classrooms of the college are well settled. The library gives you all types of books, all authors' books. In the library, you have all study-based and other types of books.

reviews.review_heading: NIT, Jalandhar, is an Institute of national importance.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi connection is provided to all the students, and the connectivity in the classroom and labs is decent. The quality of food is good, and the medical facility is brilliant here. Near the Bank inside the campus, we have a dispensary where the workers' behavior is really good. We have a badminton court, basketball, and many more clubs too.

reviews.review_heading: Average placements, average peers and value for money.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are okay. Library is very nice with good air conditioning. Wi-Fi is not good all over the institute. The quality of food in the mess is okay but in the canteen certain food items are very low. Medical facilities are nice with despansary having doctors 24/7 and free care. Sports grounds are not okay except for badminton and basketball.

reviews.review_heading: One of the best NITs in North India.
reviews.review_text: NIT Jalandhar boasts a well developed infrastructure with a great hostel and academic infrastructure. Hostel facilities are very good with good room food and very good washrooms. Free Wi-Fi is also available in entire campus and the research equipment is also very good.

reviews.review_heading: It solely depends upon you.
reviews.review_text: The Wi-Fi is okay. It sometimes stops working on its own, but the infrastructure and exposure are quite good. There are 4 or 5 canteens. There is a place for indoor games and a quite big ground for outdoor games too if you are interested, a basketball ground, a tennis court (outdoor one is being built right now), but still it is quite good, I think.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure and college life.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure for the department is very good. Wi-Fi is available throughout the campus, but some hostels are not as good as the MBH rooms, which are very good. The rest of the hostels, which are 3, 4, 5, 6, and 7 rooms, are very tiny, making it a struggle to live there. Food quality, sports facilities, and medical facilities are very good.

reviews.review_heading: I think things are changed, if a person who studies well he will definitely get a job.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the course is good, but the hostels are still not that great because they are old. However, a new hostel is under construction, and its facilities are really good. The sports facilities are good too, there are TT courts, badminton courts, and a tennis court.

reviews.review_heading: Really well-furnished infrastructure of our college with a new building and very good placement.
reviews.review_text: There are different labs in our department, like the concrete technology lab, surveying lab, geotechnical lab, and AutoCAD lab. There are ample number of classrooms in our department. We have a 3-story library in our college, and the department also provides a seating area for studying in labs and departments. For the hostel, we have a well-equipped hotel with sports facilities like table tennis and badminton court, and a gym with a common room, library, TV room, and fully air-conditioned mess.

paragraphs: DY Patil Institute of Management admissionsare both merit and entrance-based. The institute considers scores in entrance exams such as GMAT, CAT, MAH CET, MHT CET, etc. for admission to specific programmes.DY Patil Institute of Management Puneoffers courses at UG and PG levels in Management and Computer Applications streams. Interested candidates can apply online for the preferred course.

DYPIM Pune offers admission to UG courses based on merit whereas, entrance exam is considered for PG programmes. Aspirants must fulfil the course-specific eligibility to apply for admission. Below areDY Patil Institute of Management Pune coursesalong with their eligibility and selection criteria:
Note:The above eligibility and selection criteria are for All India students. The criteria might differ for Maharashtra candidates.
Download:DY Patil Institute of Management Pune Brochure

DY Patil University Puneoffers admission through DYPIM to MBA, BCA, MCA and BBA courses. The selection is both merit and entrance-based. Candidates must follow the below steps to get a seat in the institute:
Step 1: DY Patil Institute of Management Application Process 2025

Candidates meeting the eligibility criteria can apply online for the preferred course. Aspirants have to register and then fill out the application form. The application fee is non-refundable and can be paid via any of the online payment modes.
Step 2: Selection

The institute considers merit of the candidates in the last qualifying exam for BBA and BCA programmes. For MBA, the institute considers scores in MAH MBA CET, CAT, MAT, XAT, CMAT or GMAT. Candidates selected for MBA have further to pass the written ability test and personal interview round. Admission to MCA programme is based on the MAH MCA CET score.
Step 3: Merit List & Admission Confirmation

Once the selection process is over, the institute releases a merit list. The list includes the names of the selected candidates. Further, aspirants have to pay theDYPIM Punefee to confirm their seat in the institute.

individual_reviews.title: My experience at Sharnbasava University as a 2025 batch pass-out.

content.Placements: From the 2024 pass-out batch, only 4 students got placed out of 180 students in TCS and Accenture. The highest package was 7 LPA, which was given to only one student rest of the three students got 3.6 LPA and 4 LPA. individual_reviews.title: It has terrible faculty members and management. It is a complete waste of time and money.

Hostel and food facilities are decent and aligned with most private university standards, while the sports and extracurricular scene is active and encouraged.

faqs.answer: BCA is a two-year course available in two specialisations, namely Mobile application & Web Technology and Cloud and System Administartion. Candidates after completing Class 12 in relevant subjects with at least 45% aggregate (40% aggregate for reserved category) can apply for BCA courses.A pass in Class 12 with at least 45% aggregate (40% aggregate for reserved category candidates as per Maharashtra government rule) or equivalent is required to apply for the BCA course.

faqs.question: What is the cost of studying BCA at DY Patil International University?
faqs.answer: Candidates need to pay a total fee of INR 3 lakh for BCA course. The fee, include a non-refundable caution deposit of INR 10,000 . Candidates are required to pay the course fee after completion of all the selection rounds to confirm their seats. In case, a candidate is unable to pay the fee within the specified time, his or her admission will stand cancelled. Aspirants will also need to pay a registration fee to apply for admission.

faqs.question: Is there any entrance exam for BCA at DY Patil International University?

The shortlisted aspirants are called for counselling and document verification. Aspirants need to pay a course fee to confirm their seat in the university.

faqs.question: Can I join D.Y Patil International University, Pune without JEE?
faqs.answer: Yes, students can enroll in DYPIU (DY Patil International University) without taking the JEE. The eligibility criteria for the course is Class 12 with 45% aggregate and selection criteria for the course are merit-based. However, the university also accepts NET (UGC, CSIR, ICMR, DBT, ICAR), JAM, PERA, CAT, XAT, MAT, ATMA, NMAT, GATE, or GRE scores.

faqs.question: Can I get admission to D.Y Patil International University, Pune with 60% in Class 12th?
faqs.answer: Yes, candidates can get admission to DY Patil International University if you have passed Class 12 exam or an equivalent test with at least 45% aggregate (40% for applicants in the reserved category). Candidates with a high score in other qualifying exams such as NET (UGC,  CSIR, ICMR, DBT, ICAR), JAM, PERA, CAT, XAT, MAT, ATMA, NMAT,  GATE, or GRE will be preferred.

reviews.review_heading: Placements in this college are above average, and faculty is great.
reviews.review_text: Every room and lab is air-conditioned with high-quality furniture and facilities. Mess food is above average, and the hostel is also great. There are no specific sports grounds, but grounds are organized for sports events. Recently, cricket selections were held on grounds for both tennis and leather ball games.

reviews.review_heading: Review of D.Y Patil International University, Pune.
reviews.review_text: DYPIUs infrastructure for the CSE branch is modern, well-maintained, and future-ready, especially in terms of labs, smart classrooms, and learning resources. Hostel and food facilities are decent and aligned with most private university standards, while the sports and extracurricular scene is active and encouraged.

reviews.review_heading: Good college with decent placements, supportive faculty, and well-maintained infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: The campus has good infrastructure with spacious classrooms, well-equipped labs, a large library with both physical and digital resources, and decent Wi-Fi across the academic buildings. The hostel facilities are fairly comfortable but expensive, with clean rooms, 24/7 water supply, and adequate security. Mess food is average but manageable, with a mix of North and South Indian dishes. The canteen offers better options for snacks. Medical facilities are available on campus, and there are sports ...

reviews.review_heading: A solid foundation for its careers with decent placements and industry exposure.
reviews.review_text: Hostel mess and canteen, medical facilities, sports, and games are rated 10 out of 10 for quality. There are many facilities available, from basic to advanced, including computers, lights, ACs, everything is well-maintained. Sports and games are given priority.

reviews.review_heading: The best college if you have scored lower marks in competitive exams like JEE, CET, and NEET.
reviews.review_text: DYPIU has good infrastructure with all necessary facilities: Wi-Fi, library, proper classrooms, labs, etc. The canteen offers excellent food at affordable prices. Recently, DYPIU also started the best hostel in the entire Akurdi area—potentially the tallest building in Akurdi—offering facilities like sports, proper rooms, Wi-Fi, canteen, and mess, among other amenities.

reviews.review_heading: D.Y Patil International University life.
reviews.review_text: Best hostel is built by our college in Pune, the tallest building hostel DY Patil complex. Best facilities are given in our hostel to students. It has 24 24-hour security guard, gym, cafe for students, meeting point, library, clean room for students, and cleaning staff. Best hostel is there.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with the faculty members and facilities.
reviews.review_text: The college has Wi-Fi, labs, a library, and a whopping 30 or more-story hostel is under construction. The college has many courses like B.Teach, BBA BCA MCA MBA, bioengineering, b. design, mass media, etc. Medical facilities, sports events, fests, and events are awesome. The college has college clubs like theatre, painting, book club, avenues, under 25, code-decode, GDSC, etc. The food is well in hostels. We have 5 canteens in the college itself.

reviews.review_heading: Review of DY Patil International University.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure are superb. The infrastructure is aesthetic and relaxing. We have classrooms that are digitally equipped. We have a library with books from all genres. The hostel food is average, as it varies from person to person. The canteen provides tasty food. We have sports events every year.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied with the campus life, placements and management team.
reviews.review_text: College Wi-Fi, labs, classroom, library, cafeteria, open stage, auditorium, ground. Our college has a hostel under construction, which will be ready by the end of 2025. Until now, there are so many good PG and flat rental options available near the college.

reviews.review_heading: Overall good for the students focused in area of this course.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is actually pretty nice with a good campus area. With fully air-conditioned classrooms with Wi-Fi. Fully equipped laboratories with all required instruments and machines. Also have a library with required recent books, journals. A new hostel facility is also provided for students with all required amenities.

reviews.review_heading: My point of view towards my college.
reviews.review_text: Hostel provided to students with access to their rooms and facilities for their own safety and security during their stay in the hostel. Good hygiene is maintained during their time of food. Food is safe for them to eat and drink. Also, a Wi-Fi system is provided .

reviews.review_heading: I recommend this college because overall infrastructure is good, curriculum is better, free of time
reviews.review_text: I am not a hosteler, but my hostel friends told me that the food is okay. Not too good, not too bad. You can find a lot of restaurants near the college and hostel area. Since this is a main city, you can find a lot of hostels, hospitals, and everything you want.

reviews.review_heading: Love the club activities.
reviews.review_text: We have five laboratories for bioengineering students and all of them are well-equipped. The aesthetics and equipment of our laboratories are pretty advanced. Our campus has multiple canteens and my building has its own canteen with adequate accommodation.

reviews.review_heading: BCA in Cloud and Information Security.
reviews.review_text: A good strength of students completes their courses every year. It's a stress-free environment, and we may attain eligibility to join this college. Our college specializes in offering courses in BBA and BCA. Counseling is also provided to motivated and mentally unstable students.

reviews.review_heading: The smallest step of my journey.
reviews.review_text: Uninterrupted power supply and LAN-supported internet connectivity are arranged by the college. The laboratories are fitted with security cameras to monitor the activities of staff and students. It's compulsory to wear lab uniforms during lab periods; otherwise, they will collect fines from the students.

faqs.question: How can I get admission in CMR University?
faqs.answer: Check below CMR University admission process:Application:The mode of application is online. Candidates can apply on the official website of the university. The application fee for CMRUAT is INR 1000.Selection Rounds:Admission to CMR courses is both merit and entrance-based. The university conducts CMRUAT and other entrance exam for admission to specific courses. National or state-level entrance exams like CAT, MAT, JEE Main, KMAT, Karnataka PGCET, etc. are also accepted for admission.Counselling & Admission Confirmation:The shortlisted candidates are called for counselling & document verification. Aspirants must pay the course fee to confirm their seat in the university.

faqs.question: Which entrance exams are accepted by CMR University?
faqs.answer: CMR University accepts CMRUAT exam for various courses such as B.Tech, BDes, B.A. LL.B, MBA, LL. M. and BBA LL.B. Apart from this, the university also accepts CAT MAT ATMA KMAT for MBA course. Moreover, for B.Tech admissions, the entrance exams accepted apart from CMRUAT is JEE Main COMEDK, and KCET.

faqs.question: Can I get admission at School of Economics and Commerce, CMR University with 60% in Class 12?
faqs.answer: Candidates need to complete a minimum of Class 12 to apply for UG courses at School of Economics and Commerce, CMR University. The school has not specified any aggregate for UG programmes. However,  60% in Class 12 is a decent score and aspirants can get admission provided they also fulfil the selection requirements. Candidates need to pass CMRUAT for admission to UG courses.

faqs.question: Can I apply for BCom at CMR University after Class 12?
faqs.answer: Yes, candidates can apply for BCom after completing PUC/ Class 12 or equivalent exam with at least 50% aggregate. Aspirants need to pay course fee to confirm their seat in the university. The Management Quota fee for BCom course ranges between INR 3 Lacs and INR 3.75 lakh. The fee is the total of annual fee paid by the candidates every year. Aspirants are required to pay the course fee after completion of all the selection rounds to confirm their seats.
