individual_reviews.course: B.Sc.(Hons.) in IT(Artificial intelligence and Machine Learning) - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: It has good infrastructure and sports facilities. I am satisfied with the faculty members' teaching.

content.Placements: I am pursuing a B.Sc.(Hons.) in IT AI/ML from AURO University. This course falls under the School of Information Technology. The university has a collaboration with the IBM company. Many workshops are held by the university where reputed industry professionals come, and it is very helpful for us because we gain hands-on experience on real-world projects. There are compulsory internships in the 6th and 8th semesters, which help us to gain industry exposure. During every summer and winter break, we have to do short internships, which help us gain real-world experience.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc.(Hons.) in IT(Artificial intelligence and Machine Learning) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Absolutely dissatisfied with the fee structure, really good infrastructure and facilities.

content.Placements: This semester, many companies came for interviews for both internship and internship + job opportunities. The company that gave the highest package was EigoPathshala, which offered 7 LPA for the English teacher post, and the average packages offered were 4 to 4.5 LPA. From the strength of 70 students, almost 50 students were placed in the interview drive, and the rest managed it on their own. Top roles offered for AI and ML and front-end developer.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of the overall university is top grade, and classrooms are very well designed, but the class allocated to us was not in a very good condition. The labs are very nice; we have 3 labs in our university, and also we have Wi-Fi, but the Wi-Fi quality is not so good, and its speed is average. Since I don't live in the hostel, I don't know much about it, but the rooms are quite good with a 24-hour water supply and breakfast, lunch, snacks, and dinner included. The medical facilities are also very well maintained.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Arts (B.A. Hons.) - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Review of AURO University.

content.Placements: I do not know exactly how many students were placed. The highest package is around 12 lakh per year, and the lowest is 6 lakh. I don't know about recruiting companies. All the students from my batch have internships. The roles offered are communication skills, group work, event management and event operation.
content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is available on our whole campus, which is 110 acres. Labs are also there and the labs are very big in size—around 60–70 students can use the lab at 1 time. Classrooms are also very big and well maintained and the library is a very good part of our college as it has separate discussion rooms for group study.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc.(Hons.) in IT(Artificial intelligence and Machine Learning) - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: The college infrastructure and facilities are so good .

content.Placements: My college provides various packages, the highest, the lowest and average in B.Sc. Recruiting companies are Infosys, Tata consultancy services, Wipro and many more. IT companies offers the the top roles in our college.
content.Infrastructure: My college provides labs, Wi-Fi, classroom and library. College ground is available for sports and games e. g. football, volleyball and cricket etc.
content.Faculty: Teachers are helpful, qualified and knowledgeable. This course make not only make students understand how the industry works but also help organizations train students for their needs which is important for students.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc.(Hons.) in IT(Artificial intelligence and Machine Learning) - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Really good infrastructure and a healthy infrastructure .

content.Placements: This is my first year, The highest offered package is 1crore, the lowest is 25 Lacs, Average package I don't know because it's my first year. Infosys, Google, and Microsoft are the top recruiter. College first year don't know about percentage of students got internship right now.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of Auro University is just awesome all over the campus the Wi-Fi signal is available and it just help students to use the on campus Wi-Fi easily, the college also provide different login id and password for Wi-Fi login for students and faculty. Library in campus is just mind blowing every single book is available in library and there are two Library in college law library for law student and a Normal one that can access by all course of school, in library there is many rules and regulations (ex- if you borrow the book they give the time to submit it if you failed to do so you will be charged per book). In library there are 3small classroom where we students can study without and disturbance and can do group work smoothly there without any disturbance, there are two labs in college a small one and a big one in big lab it students has provided there personal computer where they can do work or save there file all the computers are new generation computers (ex:-i5 ,8gb ram, dell company computer). AC lab and AC classroom, the college is simply just awesome. I don't leave in hostel so I don't know much about hostel.

admission_process.title: AURO University Admission Process 2025

paragraphs: AURO University offers its courses via its various schools, such as theSchool of Design,School of Business,School of Law, and more. There are presently eight such schools of the university offering courses in the fields of Design, Business, Law, IT, Journalism and Mass Communication, Liberal Arts and Human Sciences, and Hospitality Management. Interested students can go through the following article to learn all about the courses, their admission criteria and admission procedures forAURO University.

AURO University course admissionis made on the basis of preset admission criteria of the desired programme. The criteria may vary from course to course or level to level. Aspirants must satisfy the minimum educational requirements in addition to providing valid entrance exam scores. AlthoughAURO University admissionsare primarily entrance-based, the university may also accept students on a merit basis if required. Students can either provide national-level exam scores or appear for the university-level exam (AURO Entrance Test).
Check out the table below to learn all about the general admission criteria for popularAuro University courses:
Eligibility
Selection Criteria

MAT| CAT|XAT| GMAT

The admission procedure for AURO University is inclusive of multiple steps. These steps include application, selection, followed by admission confirmation. Students can apply for the desired course by satisfying the admission criteria for the same. The application process generally commences online for the university. As per the university’s website, admissions are open till the seats are available. It’s on a first-come, first-served basis. Find below a step-by-stepAURO University admission processexplained:
1. Registration
While applying, candidates need to provide relevant information, such as personal details, educational qualifications, contact details and more.
2. Shortlisting of Candidates

The university shortlists candidates based on several parameters, such as past academic qualifications, entrance exam scores, SOP, PI, etc., whichever is applicable. The basic eligibility for any of the offered course requires students to pass the qualifying exam with at least 50%. Additionally, providing entrance exam scores, wherever required, is also essential. MAT/CAT/ CLAT/ CMAT, etc. accepts national-level entrance exams.
For certain courses, such as MSc, BSc, etc., students need to appear for the university-level test, followed by PI and SOP submission.
3. Document Submission and Seat Confirmation

Candidates who make it to the final merit list are then required to go through document verification and any other selection rounds as per the university’s guidelines. For seat confirmation, students need to payAURO University feesfor the desired programme.

faqs.question: What is the median package offered to BSc students at AURO University?
faqs.answer: According to the AURO University Overall NIRF Report 2025, the median package offered during the UG three-year placements in 2024 was INR 3.5 LPA . Earlier, in 2022, the median package for the same course was INR 4 LPA. Note: The above-mentioned data is not course-specific. In the absence of course-specific data, UG three-year course data has been taken from the university's Overall NIRF Report 2025.

faqs.question: What is the average package for BBA Digital Marketing students at AURO University?
faqs.answer: The common bundle for BBA Digital Marketing students at AURO University stands at INR 8.91 Lakh. This determine is indicative of the competitive area and marketplace call for for virtual advertising specialists in contemporary virtual-centric global. AURO University's curriculum probable specializes in equipping students with the modern day virtual advertising and marketing capabilities, making them especially in demand by using employers.

faqs.question: What is median package offered to MBA students at AURO University?
faqs.answer: As per the Management NIRF Report 2025, the median package offered to students enrolled in PG (2-year) courses during AURO University placements 2024 was INR 5 LPA, which was increased by 25% when compared with 2023 median package, i.e., INR 4 LPA. Note: The above-mentioned data is not course-specific.

faqs.question: How are MBA placements at AURO University?
faqs.answer: According to the AURO University Management NIRF Report 2025, a total of 33 PG (2-year) students were placed during the placement drive held in 2024. Moreover, the median package secured by the students stood at INR 5 LPA . Note: In the absence of course-specific data, PG-2-year placement data is presented.

faqs.question: How much is the total cost to complete the MBA course offered by AURO University?
faqs.answer: The AURO University MBA fee structure is a combination of multiple components. Some of the prominent components included in the fee structure are tuition fees and hostel fees. These fees are to be paid annually. Combining all, the total fee to pursue this programme ranges from INR 8.86 to 10.12 lakh . Interested students can refer to the below table to know the breakdown of the total fees: Fee components Amount Tuition Fees INR 7 lakh Hostel Fees INR 1.15 Lacs - INR 2.91 lakh One-time Payment INR 21,000 Total Fees INR 8.86 - INR 10.12 lakh Note: The above-mentioned fee is as per the official sources. However, it is indicative and subject to change.

faqs.question: What is the tuition fees for AURO University BSc (H) course?

Note: The above-mentioned fees is as per the official admission brochure. However, it is subject to change.

faqs.question: Does AURO University refund fees?
faqs.answer: Yes, they do if you are eligible under their refund policy! Refund Policy If the Student leaves AURO University before they complete their program, there shall be no entitlement to a refund of Fees and related payments except as provided for by the fee policy of AURO University. Refunds will be paid only at the discretion of the Management. For the avoidance of doubt nothing in this Policy shall require the AURO University to refund the Fees (or part thereof) unless such Fees (or part thereof) have previously been paid.

faqs.answer: To get admission to the BA course at Glocal University candidates must first have a valid BA eligibility criteria, i.e., Class 12 with 45% aggregate (40% for the SC/ST) in any stream. Eligible candidates must visit the official website of the Glocal University and register with a valid email and number. Further, candidates must fill out the online application procee and submit it. The university shortlists the students based on their class 12 exam. Shortlisted students are can visit the university campus and submit all the required documents for verification. After verification, candidates can pay the BA fee and finalise the admission.

admission_process.title: Glocal University Admission Process 2025

paragraphs: Glocal University admission 2025are both merit and entrance-based. The University offers around 80 courses at UG, PG, diploma, advance diploma and doctoral level under 14 different schools in the field of Management, Law, Engineering, Agriculture, Pharmacy, Arts, Commerce and many more. All the courses offered by the University are in full-time mode. Candidates are required to follow the specified admission process to get a chance at securing a seat in their desired programme.Glocal Universityadmission process for the session 2025-26 is ongoing.

Glocal University offers admission to UG and PG courses based on merit or national or state-level entrance exam scores. The university offers full-time courses for interested candidates. There are more than 80 courses incluing specialisations for candidates to choose from. Candidates can learn more about the university through the highlights table given below:

Admission to Glocal University's undergraduate and graduate programmes is determined by merit and results on the entrance exam for different course. Additionally, Glocal University administers entrance exams for MBA, LLM, and other course admissions. Class 12 is the minimum requirement for UG courses, whereas graduation is necessary to apply for PG programs.

The Glocal University entrance exam is used to select students for well-known programs like MBA and LLM. The eligibility and selection criteria for a few of theGlocal University coursesare listed in the table below:
Note:The information for the courses is sourced from official website/ sanctioning body and is subject to change

The whole cost of attending Glocal University includes several parts, including tuition, a caution deposit, test fees, and more. Tuition is paid annually, while other fee components, such as the caution deposit, are paid just once. Candidates are required to pay theGlocal University feethrough the means that have been made available. Check out the fee table given below:
Note:This information is sourced from official website/ sanctioning body and is subject to change.

The admissions procedure at Glocal University consists of several steps. Applicants must first submit an application for the course of their choice. The university's official website offers the application form online. Admission to courses at Glocal University is determined by entrance and merit. The detailed admissions procedure for Glocal University is described below:
Step 1: Glocal University Application Process 2025

Candidates fulfilling the eligibility requirements can apply online for Glocal University admission. As per the information collected, the application fee must be paid to register for a course. Candidates need to fill out the form and upload the specified documents to complete the application process.
Step 2: Selection Process

Glocal University shortlists candidates for most of the courses based on the merit of the candidate; they are required to appear for entrance exams for a few courses. The university considers academic merit for admission to courses like MA, PG Diploma, etc. The first level of selection after the application process will be either based on the entrance exam or academic merit.
Step 3: Document Verification and Fee Payment

Glocal University announces the names of the shortlisted candidates on a merit list following the conclusion of the selection rounds. These applicants are also contacted for document verification and counseling. To guarantee their spot at the university, applicants must pay the Glocal University fee.

review_summary.college_name: JSS Academy of Technical Education Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Good infrastructure with a green campus and decent hostels, supportive faculty.

content.Placements: The percentage of students placed is average. The highest package offered in CSE core is 45 to 50 LPA and the lowest package offered is 4 to 8 LPA. Top recruiting companies like TCS, Wipro, Infosys, IBM, HCL, Tech Mahindra, Samsung, and Amazon. The internship ratio is 100 percent but it depends on students skills and interests.
content.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure are like a green campus and decent hostel including Wi-Fi, a classroom with projectors and a library. The quality of hostel food is moderate not too bad contains four meals and hostels also have medical support 24/7, including outdoor and indoor games.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Hoping for a better placement rate in JSS, good infrastructure, and focus on skills.

content.Placements: I recently enrolled in this college, and as I have heard before, 2022, its placement was so good, even in 2020, the highest package was 60 LPA at Google. But as of now, the placement condition is too bad. Big companies are not coming to recruit, the average is only 4 LPA-6 LPA. But I am hoping that in the Next 3-4 years, the placement ratio will improve, and even big companies can also recruit.
content.Infrastructure: For infrastructure, I would say neither is too good like IIT, NIT, IIMs infra, nor too bad like other tier-2 colleges. Hostel infrastructure is better both for boys and girls. Even though the capacity is low and the buildings are old, it is a better place for B.Tech students.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering(Data Science) - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Harsh reality of JSSATE Noida.

content.Placements: Around 20 to 30 percent of students are placed. As of now, the highest package is around 15 LPA and the lowest around 3 LPA. Top recruiting companies include Accenture, Wipro, Deloitte, etc. There is no exact information about how many got internships from the course, but I guess very few, around 5 to 6, will be able to get paid internships, otherwise, most of them got unpaid internships.
content.Infrastructure: Labs are not well equipped like a typical government college. Hostels are decent; you will get both AC and non-AC rooms. Mess food is very bad, but I prefer the college hostel at least in the first year. This college is not for you if you love sports and games, no proper facilities are there.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Absolutely satisfied because of the faculty, good placement and infrastructure.

content.Placements: The placement record in college is 87 percent of students gets placed in 2024-25. The highest package is 48 LPA and lowest package is 4 LPA, and the median package is 6 LPA-8 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Infosys and Wipro. Top roles offered by companies are data development and software development.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is overall good. The labs are well. The library has AC, with good environment for studying. The hostel facility is okay. The bathrooms are not well furnished and mostly have construction issues. The food quality is okay, like other mess. The hygiene is properly maintained.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: College is good if you can work hard, it can bring you a good amount of opportunities.

content.Placements: Placements are average, not very good, but you can get enough opportunities if you can skill up yourself. According to the college placement cell, the recent batch has the highest package offer, which is 21 LPA, and the average package is approximately 6.5 LPA, which is quite average. But you can get opportunities to grab.
content.Infrastructure: Facilities are above average. The infrastructure for CSE depth of 1st year is not good since there are no AC in classrooms, but some labs are air-conditioned. Wi-Fi speed is average, not up to the mark. The hostel is good, and the mess food is edible till now. The library is top class with good infrastructure, fully air-conditioned, and a wide range of books and newspapers are available.

Application forms for all the courses are available online on the institute’s official website. If a candidate wants to apply offline, they can contact the admission office. Once the exams have been conducted, results are declared and the counselling process is completed, candidates are selected based on their merit in the exam. If they clear all the criteria, they are selected and informed. However, to confirm the seat, candidates must pay theJSS Noida fees.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure with a green campus and decent hostels, supportive faculty.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure are like a green campus and decent hostel including Wi-Fi, a classroom with projectors and a library. The quality of hostel food is moderate not too bad contains four meals and hostels also have medical support 24/7, including outdoor and indoor games.

reviews.review_heading: Hoping for a better placement rate in JSS, good infrastructure, and focus on skills.
reviews.review_text: For infrastructure, I would say neither is too good like IIT, NIT, IIMs infra, nor too bad like other tier-2 colleges. Hostel infrastructure is better both for boys and girls. Even though the capacity is low and the buildings are old, it is a better place for B.Tech students.

reviews.review_heading: Harsh reality of JSSATE Noida.
reviews.review_text: Labs are not well equipped like a typical government college. Hostels are decent; you will get both AC and non-AC rooms. Mess food is very bad, but I prefer the college hostel at least in the first year. This college is not for you if you love sports and games, no proper facilities are there.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied because of the faculty, good placement and infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is overall good. The labs are well. The library has AC, with good environment for studying. The hostel facility is okay. The bathrooms are not well furnished and mostly have construction issues. The food quality is okay, like other mess. The hygiene is properly maintained.

reviews.review_heading: College is good if you can work hard, it can bring you a good amount of opportunities.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are above average. The infrastructure for CSE depth of 1st year is not good since there are no AC in classrooms, but some labs are air-conditioned. Wi-Fi speed is average, not up to the mark. The hostel is good, and the mess food is edible till now. The library is top class with good infrastructure, fully air-conditioned, and a wide range of books and newspapers are available.

reviews.review_heading: Ample facilities but infrastructure from inside is much desired.
reviews.review_text: From outside, it looks good, but inside, classes are a little shabby, and roads are well paved, with an abundance of parking spaces. You also get Wi-Fi for all students, great library access, and well-built labs. There are hostels with AC and without AC. The choice is yours and also depends on availability.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure, facilities, teachers, and everything.
reviews.review_text: Very good facilities of Wi-Fi, library, classrooms, and labs are available. There are the best hostels ever, with bigger rooms, Wi-Fi connection, and good food. They have 3 shared rooms and a single room, and have AC and non-AC rooms. They provide vegetarian food and snacks. They have a water cooler and a filter also.

reviews.review_heading: A complete review of my college.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is what makes it stand above the rest. It has top-notch hostel facilities and good and spacious classrooms. The infrastructure stands at the top of the list. In our hostels, we have both AC hostel (ISH) and non-AC hostel (BH). Both the hostels have quality rooms.

reviews.review_heading: The college has a great infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: On campus, hostels are available, including both air-conditioned and non-air-conditioned options. Veg foods are served in the mess, while non-veg foods are not on the menu. Sports facilities are also available on campus, providing great opportunities.

reviews.review_heading: Average college with a good location advantage.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms do not have ACs or even smart boards. Teachers are using old-style blackboards The labs are fine and you can get Wi-Fi access for your laptop. The hostels are good with all the facilities, the mess food is also eatable and on some days, it could be great too.

reviews.review_heading: Review of JSS Academy of Technical Education.
reviews.review_text: There is a separate building for every course or department. Every department has its own library, labs, Wi-Fi, halls, and many classrooms. Hostel is good because you have a choice of rooms. You can choose a deluxe hostel room or a simple hostel room. But the food is average. There are many sports. You can play in your hostel as well as in college.

reviews.review_heading: College is very good and no disappointments.
reviews.review_text: There are very nice infrastructure in the college and good libraries are present where we get the articles to read nice books for pharmacy are provided. Sports events are done per year. The food canteen is very good with good hostel facilities and good mess food.

reviews.review_heading: College is overall good if you are a brilliant, but not for below-average students
reviews.review_text: Everything was good, but classrooms are not fully equipped as AC is not provided by the college. The library is good, and there is a motivating environment for study. Sports and canteen facilities are available, but medical facilities are not. The campus is Wi-Fi enabled, and there is an auditorium and transport services available.

reviews.review_heading: JSS’s honest truth with all its upsides and downsides, so don’t miss it.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms aren’t air-conditioned and are really suffocating in the summer. But the library is fully air-conditioned and Wi-Fi is okay. The girls’ hostel is really good; it has both AC and non-AC rooms, the food is good and hygienic, and there are sports facilities. The labs have AC and are well-equipped.

reviews.review_heading: JSS, Noida is still relevant in 2025.
reviews.review_text: Hostel food is below average and quality degrades in night food. Hostel life is good, with sufficient campus area for any sports. There are school-like classrooms with no AC and coolers, classes become bad in the summers, and decent infrastructure still needs improvement.

admission_process.title: COER University, Roorkee Admission Process 2025

paragraphs: COER University, Roorkee admission is both entrance and merit-based for programmes offered at UG, PG, and After 10th levels. A few popular exams accepted by the institution for admission are JEE Main, GATE, and CAT, etc. However, for admission to B.E. / B.Tech, B.Voc, and B.Sc., etc. courses, the college considers the scores of past academics for admission. COER University has 12 colleges through which it offers over 80 courses. The duration for UG courses offered at COER University, Roorkee ranges between 3 - 4 years and the same for PG courses ranges between 2 - 3 years.

COER University admission to UG and PG courses is entrance-based. Students must fulfil the minimum eligibility criteria to get admission to the respective courses atCOER University. Check below the course-wise eligibility and selection criteria for the COER University course admissions 2025:
Pass graduation with a minimum 50% aggregate
MAT/CAT/Merit
A pass in Class 12 with at least 45% aggregate (40% in case reserved category)
Class 12 with at least 45% aggregate
Candidate must have Passed class 12 exam or equivalent with minimum 45% marks in total in the qualifying examination. (With additional bridge course for Mathematics background students)

COER University admissions are merit-based but it accepts scores of National level exams for UG and PG courses. To secure admission to the COER University courses, applicants must qualify for all the selection parameters. Firstly, they must submit the application form and proceed further. The step-wise details around the complete process forCOER University admission 2025are mentioned below:

The mode of application is online. Candidates need to apply either on the official website of COER University or the respective courses. All the aspirants can apply directly on the official website of the institute.

To get admission to the COER University, candidates must first qualify for the respective state/ national-level entrance exam with a valid score and proceed with the other selection rounds or the selection can be done based on merit.

After the final result declaration, the selected candidates will have to appear for the GGSIPU Counselling process (for UG & PG courses) and a merit list of the selected candidates will be released on the official website ofCOER University. For the PGDM course, direct admission is offered to candidates after completing the selection process.
Step 4: Final Admission
After receiving the final selection notification, candidates have to pay a certain amount of fee to confirm their admission.

faqs.question: What is the accepted entrance exam for COER University MTech admissions?
faqs.answer: COER University offers MTech in Computer Science and Engineering and MTech in Mechanical Engineering via College of Engineering Roorkee. For admission to these courses, the institute accepts GATE scores. Those who do not have a valid GATE score can appear for the college level entrance test. However, students must also note that the first preference is given to students who have qualified the GATE exam.Interested students can also check out otherMTech Colleges accepting GATE in Delhi/NCR.

faqs.question: Am I eligible for government jobs after completing MTech from COER University, Roorkee?
faqs.answer: Yes, students who have completed their MTech degree from COER University are eligible for various jobs in the public sector. The role and responsibilities differ based on choice of specialisations. For example, students who have specialised in Mechanical Engineering are eligible to apply for a variety ofrailway positionssuch asAssistant Engineer, CMRL, Project Manager,etc. Students with a degree in Computer Science can look out for job titles such asSoftware Engineer, Data Analyst, Data Engineer

faqs.question: What are the courses offered at COER University, Roorkee?
faqs.answer: COER University, Roorkee provides various UG, PG, diploma, and doctoral programmes. Some of the courses offered by the university include BTech, BVoc, BSc, BBA, BCom, BDes, BHM, MTech, MBA, MCom, MDes, MPH, MHA, MSc, MCA, PhD, diploma, etc. under various colleges such as Engineering, Smart Computing, Pharmacy, Smart Agriculture, Business Studies, Nursing, Paramedical Sciences, Health Sciences.

faqs.question: Can I get direct admission to COER University?
faqs.answer: No, direct admission to COER University is not possible. The admission to the courses offered at COER University is done on the basis of merit or national level entrance exams, such as JEE, CAT, MAT.

faqs.question: Are there any government job opportunities that I can seek after completing BTech from COER University, Roorkee?
faqs.answer: Yes, students who have graduated with a BTech degree from COER University can seek out job opportunities in the public sector. Pursuing a BTech degree helps students cultivate various skills such as problem-solving, critical thinking, and more. BTech graduates can seek job opportunities at reputed government companies such as Indian Railways, ONGC, BHEL, ISRO, and others. Fresh graduates are generally offered entry-level titles such as Research Assistant, Jr. Developer, Software Engineer, Quality Analyst, and such. The starting salary offered to fresh graduates working in the public sector ranges from INR 4 to 6 LPA . Interested students can even take government exams such as UPSC, SSC, etc., to broaden their career horizons.

reviews.review_heading: COER University is the greatest university I have ever known.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is awesome, and the nature of teachers is great. They always motivate us to work hard and be disciplined students. All the departments have a very good environment, and the infrastructure is brilliant. It is great. It is a very genuine college, and I proudly say I am a Coerian.

reviews.review_heading: Faculty is good, and I hope this feedback is helpful for everyone.
reviews.review_text: Facilities such as labs, classrooms, Wi-Fi, gym, passion, and many more are provided to students at our university. The quality of the facilities in our university hostels is good, as well as the food available in the mess and canteen, and medical services.

reviews.review_heading: COER University review.
reviews.review_text: Our college provided world-class infrastructure with modern labs, well-defined classrooms, and hostels with Wi-Fi facilities. It provided sports and cultural scope. All labs were modern and consisted of every equipment. Classrooms were designed with smart LED panel for smart study.

reviews.review_heading: Don't take admission please.
reviews.review_text: Facilities were very poor even the air-conditioners were not working properly. If there was heavy rain then the water filled up the ground floor, and there was no way to remove that water. There was no good infrastructure or places to study, and even the classes were small.

reviews.review_heading: The college had a history that was decent.
reviews.review_text: I was in the hostel for 2 years, and in those two years, the Wi-Fi didn't work a single day, and they are stating themselves as an engineering college. Classrooms and labs are present on the campus. There is no AC facility, due to which it becomes too hot in class.

reviews.review_heading: It has good faculty members, average infrastructure, and below-average hostels.
reviews.review_text: Almost all the facilities are available. There is good internet speed in labs. It has working computers. Labs are spacious and in good condition. There are hygienic and spacious classrooms. In the hostel, we have Wi-Fi, laundry, etc. Rooms are not that big. It is also overpriced according to the facilities that they provide. The infrastructure is also not that bad.

reviews.review_heading: Decent infrastructure and faculty but needs much improvement in placements.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is decent. Labs are available and well-equipped. Wi-Fi facility is available on campus. The hostel facilities are decent. I am not a hostelite so can't say that much but overall infrastructure is nice and one of the best in Roorkee.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with all facilities provided by the college.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure of our college is up to date and good. If someone wants to join the college he/she would experience a really good infrastructure in the college with an area of 75 acres. The college provides a green environment and a lush green campus.

reviews.review_heading: COER University, Uttarakhand
reviews.review_text: In our college, the infrastructure is good and well-maintained, with many facilities available here, like a cafeteria, gym, basketball court, and more. COER University also provides separate hostels for boys and girls. The hostels are very good, well-maintained, and have good infrastructure.

reviews.review_heading: I am neutral for my college review at last we have to prepare on our own.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is good in our department and labs but the system and internet facility in labs are average. Library facility is good. Hostel facility is average and the food quality is average as well. All types of sports like football, cricket, volleyball, and basketball are available. Annual fest of sports, Run is conducted.

reviews.review_heading: A good and average college for those who can afford the private colleges.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is good. There are multiple facilities provided for students like many labs, Wi-Fi availability at every place, different labs, and many extra circular activities. The quality of the mess food is great. There is a hospital for medical facilities which are run by the college. Multiple games are played on campus like cricket, volleyball, basketball, kabaddi, football, and many more.

reviews.review_heading: Really good infrastructure with satisfied amount of placement from the college.
reviews.review_text: In hostel room, they provide you with a table, chair, cooler, attached bathroom, and bed. There is also an AC room according to your needs. And in the hostel, there is a badminton and basketball court, and the quality of food is good, and they maintain proper hygiene in the mess.

reviews.review_heading: A college with good infrastructure and knowledgeable teachers.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, a library, a hostel, a playground, a cafe, medical, and many more facilities are available in the college. We have good and huge infrastructure. There is a clean area. Our college has a parking area for cars and bikes. It has great security at every gate.

reviews.review_heading: It has attractive infrastructure and good food quality in the mess and cafeteria.
reviews.review_text: COER University has an attractive infrastructure as there are four buildings with three floors for different lectures. It has laboratories like mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, chemistry laboratories, computer laboratories with Wi-Fi, and the best brand of computers. The library is updated with the latest published books. The hostel has many facilities like neat and clean washrooms, rooms, etc. The mess food quality is acceptable. The canteen named COER Cafeteria is best for eatin...

reviews.review_heading: Fresher's viewpoint of college.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is very impressive. The campus is surrounded by lush greenery and is well-maintained. Wi-Fi is available on the campus. Classrooms are equipped with projectors. There is a specific building for computer labs.
